description: This is a C# class named ToastComponent which is a Blazor component responsible for displaying toast notifications with various levels (Info, Success, Warning, Error). It manages visibility, styling, and message content for toast messages, subscribing to events from a ToastService.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: Blazor component for displaying toast notifications, implementing IDisposable to unsubscribe from service events on disposal.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for showing and hiding toast notifications when the component is initialized.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles the display of toast messages by configuring settings based on the toast level and message received.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Sets visual styling and heading based on the toast notification level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from toast service events to prevent memory leaks when the component is disposed.
